Каждая клетка тела — копия одной-единств: Every cell in the body is a copy of a single fertilized egg. How a cell doubles its DNA and splits in two — and how sex cells get exactly half the chromosomes.
<b>Клеточный цикл</b> — жизнь клетки от: The cell cycle is a cell’s life from one division to the next (≈ 24 h in dividing human cells). G1 — growth and work; S — DNA replication: each chromosome gets a sister copy; G2 — checks and preparation; M — mitosis. Checkpoints (p53 and others) halt the cycle if DNA is damaged; cells that stop dividing rest in G0.
<b>Интерфаза.</b> ДНК уже удвоена: у каж: Interphase. DNA is already copied: each chromosome has two sister chromatids, but it is still unwound in the nucleus (chromatin). The centrosome has doubled too — the future spindle poles.
<b>Профаза.</b> Хромосомы спирализуются: Prophase. Chromosomes coil up and become visible as X shapes. Centrosomes move apart and the microtubules of the mitotic spindle grow between them; the nuclear envelope starts to break down.
<b>Прометафаза.</b> Оболочки ядра больше: Prometaphase. The nuclear envelope is gone. Microtubules from opposite poles grab the kinetochores — protein “hooks” on the centromere of each sister.
<b>Метафаза.</b> Хромосомы выстроены на: Metaphase. Chromosomes line up on the metaphase plate in the middle. The cell waits until every sister is attached to its pole — otherwise division will not start (spindle checkpoint).
<b>Анафаза.</b> Белок, скреплявший сестё: Anaphase. The protein holding sisters together (cohesin) is cut, and the spindle pulls them to the poles. Each chromatid is now a chromosome of its own. The cell elongates.
<b>Телофаза и цитокинез.</b> У полюсов с: Telophase and cytokinesis. Two new nuclei form at the poles, chromosomes unwind, and a furrow splits the cytoplasm. Mitosis ends with two identical cells, each with the full set (46 chromosomes in humans).
<b>Профаза I.</b> Главное отличие мейоза: Prophase I. The key difference in meiosis: homologous chromosomes — from mother (pink) and from father (blue) — pair up. Their chromatids swap segments — crossing over — creating new combinations of genes.
<b>Метафаза I.</b> На пластинке стоят <b: Metaphase I. Pairs of homologs, not single chromosomes, stand on the plate. Which homolog goes left and which goes right is random: pair B faces the other way from pair A (independent assortment).
<b>Анафаза I.</b> Расходятся <b>гомологи: Anaphase I. Homologs separate while sisters stay together. The chromosome number is halved — that is why meiosis is called reduction division.
<b>Телофаза I.</b> Получились две клетки: Telophase I. Two cells, each with half the set (23 chromosomes in humans), but every chromosome still has two chromatids, now mixed by crossing over.
<b>Метафаза II.</b> Второе деление похож: Metaphase II. The second division is like mitosis: in both cells chromosomes line up on their own plates, and the spindle attaches to the sisters from both sides.
<b>Анафаза и телофаза II.</b> Сёстры рас: Anaphase and telophase II. Sisters separate, giving four cells with a single set (n = 23), all genetically different. This is how sperm and eggs form; fertilization restores 46.
\n <div><h2>Клеточный цикл</h2>\n:
The cell cycle

Interphase takes ≈ 95 % of the cycle: G1 (growth, protein synthesis), S (DNA replication — see “DNA”), G2 (preparing to divide). Mitosis (M) lasts about an hour. Cells that no longer divide (neurons, cardiomyocytes) leave the cycle and rest in G0.

The cycle is driven by cyclins and cyclin-dependent kinases and halted by checkpoints: in G1 (DNA damage, the p53 protein), in G2 and in metaphase (are all chromosomes attached to the spindle?).

Mitosis and meiosis

  • Mitosis: one cell → two genetically identical cells, set 2n = 46. Growth, renewal of skin and blood, healing.
  • Meiosis: two divisions in a row → four cells with a set n = 23, all different thanks to crossing over and independent assortment. Spermatogenesis and oogenesis.

Medicine

A tumor is cells that escaped cycle control (mutations in p53, RB and others). Many anticancer drugs target division: vincristine and taxanes disrupt the spindle, others damage DNA in S phase. Nondisjunction in meiosis causes trisomies: an extra chromosome 21 is Down syndrome.

Conventions

  • 2 chromosome pairs are shown instead of 23 in humans; length and thickness are schematic, interphase chromatin is shown as simplified unwound rods.
  • Color: pink — chromosomes from the mother, blue — from the father; in crossing over, non-sister chromatids of the homologs swap the lower arm (in reality, only segments).
  • The spindle is drawn as straight lines from the poles to the centromeres; phase durations are sped up.
